text:
alyssa: FYI saw a bump in invoice preview token counts for a small tenant cohort at 03:12 UTC. Looks like duplicate preview lines, not final invoices. filing here to triage

sam: yup i saw that in the ingest logs. pattern: provisional metering emitted with epoch=null then a final commit with epoch later. preview shows both until dedupe finishes

mira: can you paste an example log line? want to confirm fields and ordering

sam: example:
INFO 2026-03-22T03:12:01Z ingest request_id=ri_9b3 epoch_id=null route=embed-heavy tokens=129 status=accepted
INFO 2026-03-22T03:12:02Z joiner commit request_id=ri_9b3 epoch_id=epoch-20260322-03 tokens=129 status=joined

jordan: that creates two preview items. final invoices run later dedupe so users don't get double-charged, but preview UX is noisy and triggers support tickets

alyssa: short-term mitigation idea: console can collapse preview rows when a matching final commit appears within 5m. Low-risk and quick. Longer term we should reduce the root cause

mira: agreed. Another option: per-route toggle in routing config "billing-consistent-mode" that makes edge wait a small window (20-100ms) for epoch assignment before emitting provisional. tradeoff: slight p50 latency increase for cleaner previews

sam: implementation sketch: edge-proxy attaches provisional_epoch if known or waits up to X ms behind feature flag `ingest.bump/provisional_epoch`. emit provisional with flag otherwise. metering-preview pipeline then uses provisional_epoch||final_epoch to dedupe before preview emit. also add telemetry counters: metering.provisional_emitted, metering.provisional_wait_ms, metering.duplicate_preview_count

jordan: also found retries sometimes generate a new request_id which breaks dedupe. suggest passing client_request_id header from SDK and using (request_id, client_request_id) as secondary dedupe key in the dedupe store

ops-bot: INC-4821 suppressed for tenant cohort while mitigations are applied :information_source:

alyssa: owners: mira -> console collapse + modal copy for route toggle. sam -> edge change behind feature flag + telemetry. jordan -> metering-ingest dedupe change + e2e tests simulating late-join ordering. timeline: console quick fix today, feature-flagged infra in 48h, canary for one week

mira: i'll draft modal text: "Enable billing-consistent-mode for this route: small increase in median request latency in exchange for reduced duplicate preview items and more stable invoice previews." will post screenshots in PR

sam: opening PR for edge-proxy WIP: https://git.redwood.company/edge-proxy/pulls/813

jordan: WIP PR for metering-ingest dedupe: https://git.redwood.company/metering-ingest/pulls/130

alyssa: good. next check-in 11:00 PT in channel. if you see another preview spike tag me with logs and sample request_id. thanks :thumbsup:
